recognize_zh: 這不是顯微鏡影像，而是手繪示意圖「Figure 1B」：血管內皮活化，白血球、紅血球、血小板黏附於血管壁，並有 NETs、血小板-白血球聚集體、微粒、凝血酶與細胞激素；用來說明 MPN 的血栓發炎狀態。注意此圖實為 Figure 1B，並非標題與說明所指的 Figure 2。
features: Hand-drawn schematic of a blood vessel lumen labeled FIGURE 1B
Activated endothelial cells lining both walls with adherent leukocytes, red cells and platelets
Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) and platelet-leukocyte aggregates within the lumen
Circulating microparticles, thrombin (TH) and cytokines (X) depicted
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic, hand-drawn schematic (labeled Figure 1B) rather than a microscopic image. It depicts a blood vessel in which activated endothelial cells bind activated leukocytes, red cells and platelets, with neutrophil extracellular traps, platelet-leukocyte aggregates, microparticles, thrombin generation and cytokine release in the lumen. It illustrates the prothrombotic, pro-adhesive thromboinflammatory milieu in myeloproliferative neoplasms. Note that the image corresponds to Figure 1B, whereas the record title and description refer to Figure 2 (the CHIP/MPN/inflammation flow diagram).
